title: Flood Layers — Combined Depth Classes
description: Combined flooded-area FeatureCollection containing features from all water-depth classes. Each feature must carry a 'level_cm' property identifying its depth class (e.g. 20, 30, … 100 cm). Used by the well-being hazard pipeline (all depth levels, Steps 4.1–4.2) and the mobility & accessibility hazard pipeline (single depth level, default 30 cm, Steps 3.1–3.2).

level_cm.description: Water depth class this feature represents [cm]
